notes.title: Hotfix | 09.29
notes.notes:
Hey there, survivors!

Another patch with a few changes and some fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a mutation to remain after treatment
[*] Fixed a bug with character name change after the first raid
[*] By popular demand, added mouse control! Hold down the LKM during a raid
[*] Baseball bat. Added at 3rd and 6th level visible enhancements – plus 1 projectile
[*] Temporarily fixed the issue, causing black screen upon the launch. Turned off starting cut-scene for the time being
[*] Mutation Timer. Removed timers, decreased time to cure
[/list]

Thank you for the positive and constructive feedback! We're so excited to see your interest in the game and can't wait for y'all to jump into the full version!

Stay tuned for the updates on the full game and follow the development by adding the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510/FatalZone/]full game[/url] to your wishlist and joining the [url=https://discord.gg/BZwCAS2Vma]official Discord server[/url] of the game!

notes.title: Hotfix | 09.27
notes.notes:
Hey there, survivors!

We've heard your reports about the issues with the [b]evacuation helicopter[/b], and we're happy to share that the issue [b]has been solved[/b] in this hotfix update!

Along with this, we've made a couple of minor changes based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Snorkel and dried up zombie color correction
[*] Optimization of the effect of dust from the evacuation helicopter
[*] Optimization of the level up window
[*] Fix for the stats scrolling in win/loss windows
[*] Fix for the bosses' health bar UI
[*] Fixed resource counting in the equipment upgrades menu
[/list]

And that's about it! Thank you so much for your support and feedback!

If you liked what we've got so far, please consider leaving a review of FatalZone: Outbreak on Steam and adding the full game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510/FatalZone/
